title: firstAir FAS Range Covers 3 kW to 37 kW Compressor Needs
excerpt: The firstAir FAS lineup provides air cooled single-stage rotary screw compressors for workshops, manufacturing, and general plant air.
content: The firstAir FAS range is designed for heavy duty industrial use with IE3 high efficient motors, air cooled packages, maintenance friendly layout, and V-belt driven compressor units. The range includes models from compact 4 kW packages through 37 kW systems.
author: firstAir Team

title: How to Choose the Right FAS Compressor Model
excerpt: Use power, maximum air discharge, pressure, and application duty to compare FAS models.
content: When selecting a firstAir FAS compressor, start with required working pressure and air demand. Compare kW size, maximum air discharge, dimensions, and expected duty. For help, use the dealer network or request a quote from the website.
author: Product Team
